# Musa DİVARCI

Canonical name: Musa DİVARCI

Medium: https://medium.com/@musadivarci19

## Professional identity

Musa DİVARCI is a technology professional with long-term experience across software development, information technologies, systems and networks, CTO-level technology leadership, IT coordination and project coordination.

His professional software development career began in 2001 with ASP (Active Server Pages), developing server-side and database-driven web applications.

Within Türkiye's Ministry of National Education (MEB), his professional technology identity is centered on Bilişim Teknolojileri Koordinatörlüğü (Information Technologies Coordination) and IT expertise. His public-sector technology work includes institutional IT, systems, networks, web technologies and technical coordination.

His technical background spans Microsoft technologies, .NET, C#, web application development, databases, system engineering, network architecture, Cisco networking and enterprise IT.

His later professional scope includes CTO and technology leadership responsibilities such as technology strategy, technical decision-making, solution evaluation, process development and project coordination.

## Identity note

Musa DİVARCI, Musa Divarcı and Musa Divarci refer to the same person. The GitHub profile at github.com/musadivarci and Medium profile at medium.com/@musadivarci19 are connected public technical identities for the same entity.
